newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Man charged in NZ shooting spree appears in court.
newsitem.headline: Man charged in NZ shooting spree appears in court.

text.p: A New Zealand man appeared in court on Sunday charged with the murder of one of six people massacred in a central north island town.
Stephen Anderson, 22, of Wellington appeared in the Taumarunui district court and was formally charged with murdering Hendrick Derek Young Van de Wetering.
Anderson showed no emotion as he appeared in police overalls before Justice of the Peace Jock Black and was remanded in custody to appear in the Hamilton District Court on Wednesday.

No application was made for bail or suppression of his name. A psychiatric report has been ordered on Anderson, who is unemployed. There were few people at the court for the special session shortly after 3:00 p.m. (0200 GMT).
Police said other charges were pending.

Van de Wetering was one of six people killed and five wounded when a gunman went on a rampage at the hamlet of Raurimu, 34 km (21 miles) southeast of Taumarunui. The names of the other victims have not been released.
